scenes.narration: The terrifying part is, I am no longer immune to you.

scenes.narration: I used to be fine on my own.

scenes.narration: I was good at keeping people at a distance.

scenes.narration: But one message from you can change my whole mood.
scenes.image_query: But one message from you can change my whole mood.

scenes.narration: Your laugh gets through me when nothing else can.

scenes.narration: And the way you look at me makes everything else feel far away.
